_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::ssi#5 and the execution that FALSIFIED both halves of its Signal. 'block' with a direct UMFPACK solver is not wasteful — on upstream ssi_mono_3D_1hex8_scatra.4C.yaml it simply runs and passes every result test. The two real failures are hard aborts, not exploding iteration counts: a scatra MATRIXTYPE of block_condition with a direct solver gives 'Global system matrix with block structure requires AMGnxn, MueLu or Teko block preconditioner!' from src/scatra/4C_scatra_timint_implicit.cpp, and forcing SSI CONTROL/MONOLITHIC MATRIXTYPE to sparse on the upstream Teko/BGS-AMG 5x5 deck gives 'Incompatible matrix type associated with scalar transport field!' from src/ssi/4C_ssi_monolithic.cpp inside SsiMono::setup_system(). Neither run reaches a solve. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Global system matrix with block structure requires AMGnxn, MueLu or Teko block preconditioner!
Incompatible matrix type associated with scalar transport field!

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the scatra-block arm: do not inject a block_condition scatra matrix. The direct solver is then legal, EXIT_BLOCKSCATRA becomes 0 and the preconditioner diagnostic vanishes, so the fixture must go red.

remove the pathology from the Teko arm: leave the upstream block MATRIXTYPE alone. It then matches the block scatra field, EXIT_TEKOSPARSE becomes 0 and the incompatible-matrix diagnostic vanishes, so the fixture must go red.
